title: Conjunctions & Connectors: Cause, Contrast & Logical Flow
subtitle: CEFR B1–B2 • Subordinating Clauses (Although, Despite, Since) & Discourse Markers

topics.title: 1. Contrast Connectors (Although, Even Though vs. Despite)
topics.subtitle: Clause Connectors vs. Noun Phrase Prepositions
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua ide yang bertentangan. 'Although / Even though' wajib diikuti subjek + kata kerja (klausa lengkap), sedangkan 'Despite / In spite of' hanya diikuti kata benda atau V-ing.
topics.rationale: Kesalahan paling sering pada pembelajar B1 adalah menaruh kalimat lengkap langsung setelah 'despite'. Memisahkan keduanya menjaga struktur kalimat tetap kokoh.

formulas.pattern: Although / Even though + [S + V], [Main Clause]  |  Despite + [Noun / V-ing], [Main Clause]
Although + S + Aux + not + V, [Result]  |  Despite + [Negative Noun], [Result]

conditionalExamples.positive: Although the deadline was tight, we shipped the feature on time.
conditionalExamples.negative: Despite having limited resources, the team didn't compromise on quality.
conditionalExamples.question: Did you finish the migration despite the network outage?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Setelah 'despite', kata kerja 'have' berubah menjadi gerund 'having'.

xrayTokens.nuance: Tidak boleh diikuti kalimat utuh tanpa 'the fact that'

specialExceptions.title: Jangan Menggabungkan 'Although' dan 'But' dalam Satu Kalimat
specialExceptions.explanation: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita sering berkata 'Meskipun..., tetapi...'. Dalam bahasa Inggris, pilih salah satu saja.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: Although it was raining, but we still went out.
specialExceptions.correctExample: Although it was raining, we still went out.

tipsAndTricks: Jika terlanjur mengucapkan 'Despite...' dan ingin menyambungnya dengan kalimat utuh, tambahkan jembatan 'the fact that': 'Despite the fact that it rained...'

topics.title: 2. Cause & Result Connectors (Since, As, Therefore, Consequently)
topics.subtitle: Articulating Logical Reasoning in Discussions & Reports
topics.explanation: Selain 'because', penutur B1–B2 menggunakan 'since' dan 'as' untuk alasan yang sudah dipahami bersama, serta 'therefore' atau 'as a result' untuk menarik kesimpulan logis.
topics.rationale: Memvariasikan kata hubung sebab-akibat membuat presentasi bisnis dan argumen tertulis terdengar terstruktur dan meyakinkan.

formulas.pattern: Since + S + Aux + not + V, [Alternative Action]

conditionalExamples.positive: Since traffic peaks at noon, we configured auto-scaling in advance.
conditionalExamples.negative: The third-party API was deprecated; therefore, we didn't integrate it.
conditionalExamples.question: Since everyone is online, shall we start the sprint review?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'Since' di awal kalimat memberikan konteks alasan secara halus sebelum menyampaikan keputusan utama.

specialExceptions.title: 'Because' (Klausa) vs. 'Because of' (Frasa Benda)
specialExceptions.explanation: 'Because' diikuti S + V, sedangkan 'because of' atau 'due to' diikuti kata benda.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: The flight was delayed because heavy fog.
specialExceptions.correctExample: The flight was delayed because of heavy fog.

tipsAndTricks: Gunakan 'Due to + Noun' untuk laporan kerja yang formal (e.g., 'Due to server maintenance, the portal will be offline').

scenario.interlocutor: Engineering Manager membaca ringkasan pemulihan sistem
scenario.intent: Menyampaikan kontras antara tingginya trafik dan stabilitas sistem.

practiceQuiz.question: Pilih kalimat yang benar secara tata bahasa:

options.text: Despite traffic increased by 300%, the server stayed online.
Despite a 300% surge in traffic, the server stayed online.
Although a 300% surge in traffic, the server stayed online.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: 'Despite' diikuti frasa kata benda ('a 300% surge in traffic') tanpa kata kerja di dalamnya.
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A menaruh klausa (S + V) setelah 'despite', dan Opsi C menaruh frasa benda tanpa kata kerja setelah 'although'.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Rumus anti-salah: Although + S + V | Despite + Noun / V-ing.
